verdict.rationale: The docs say a run handle can be used to check status, cancel and retry a task. Tasks also auto-retry with exponential backoff, and the run page shows a trace view with logs, so a failed run can be rerun and inspected. Nothing documents replaying a run from its recorded history or resuming from a specific step. Missing for 10: explicit replay/rerun of a failed run from the dashboard or API using its original payload, rerun from a specific step or checkpoint, detailed docs on the retry/replay semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
